description.value: Charles Richardson Nature Reserve is a protected natural area in Surrey, BC, catalogued in City of Surrey GIS data. As a nature reserve in the Lower Mainland, it likely offers trails and natural habitat for wildlife observation. Touring cyclists in the Fraser Valley area may find it a worthwhile off-bike detour.
